defense_news.title: Italy taps state-owned firms to build two naval destroyers in $4.2 billion deal
defense_news.summary: Italy has signed to buy two new naval destroyers that will mark a quantum leap in capabilities for the Italian navy, the ships’ builders have promised.

defense_news.title: US to provide critical but more limited capabilities to NATO, top commander says
defense_news.summary: NATO’s top commander said on Thursday the United States would continue to provide “critical but more limited capabilities” to the alliance.

defense_news.title: Why the last tactical mile is crucial to acquisition reform
defense_news.summary: If acquisition reform is to succeed, it must migrate to the warfighter's last tactical mile, the president and chief executive officer of CNA writes.

defense_news.title: With Denmark, Saildrone logs first flag registration for naval surveillance drone
defense_news.summary: U.S. naval drone maker Saildrone seeks to expand its footprint in Europe, with Denmark a key customer in the contested Baltic and North seas.
